protocolName: Complete-card, counted-result, likeness/symbol, and global-parallelism protocol
rationale: The six deictic claims depend on short cards whose sublines define product scope and promotions. The result montage contains motion-dependent changes, a Steve Jobs-like single example with Apple symbol, two conservatively grouped Runway looks, three distinct 12-thumbnail Manus grids, and an image-tool-to-animation boundary. The same presenter/room and hard cuts organize a parallel list without handoffs. Every OCR action must be followed by Vision OCR and human frame checking; non-speech audio is handled separately as technically present but semantically unresolved.

knowledgeUnitFields.reason: Product name, category/source description, and promotional qualifier must not be merged into external fact.

knowledgeUnitFields.name: verbatimCueAndBurnedSubtitle

knowledgeUnitFields.name: conservativeCountAndGroupingRule

knowledgeUnitFields.name: claimScopeAssessment

knowledgeUnitFields.name: gestureGazeReactionRole

knowledgeUnitFields.name: layoutAndSpatialRole

knowledgeUnitFields.name: nonSpeechAudioDecision
knowledgeUnitFields.reason: The media has audio and technical inspection finds continuous energy through speech gaps, but semantic role is unresolved.

knowledgeUnitFields.name: globalContinuityAndStructure
knowledgeUnitFields.reason: The same presenter/room unifies six parallel entries and no cross-tool pipeline is shown.

knowledgeUnitFields.name: unshownWorkflowCausalityAndHandoffs

knowledgeUnitFields.name: cueDisposition

knowledgeUnitFields.name: evidenceRefsAndBoundedTime
knowledgeUnitFields.reason: All core units and relations need resolvable cue/shot/frame/OCR evidence with bounded time.

captureActions.carrier: same presenter/room, repeated card placement, pointing rhythm, and hard-cut entry boundaries

audioInspectionActions.method: ffprobe audio-stream check, extracted mono review track, silence detection at -35 dB for 0.2 s, and full-track spectrogram
audioInspectionActions.reason: Handle non-speech audio separately from transcript-bearing speech.
audioInspectionActions.stoppingDecision: Record continuous non-speech-capable audio energy and final silence; preserve exact music/effect semantics as unknown because playback could not be semantically resolved.

stoppingRules: Stop only after Vision OCR has run on all OCR/UI actions and each accepted high-impact line has been checked against its source frame.
Stop only when every legible line of all six cards is represented with OCR line references or explicitly marked unreadable.
Stop only when the full 0–16.556 s carrier sweep remains gap-free and every carrier traces to discoveredIn sweep IDs.
Stop only when every cue has a cueAccountability row and links to knowledge units.
Stop only when three distinct Manus grids and 12 visible thumbnails per grid are evidenced with the 3×4 grouping rule.
Stop only when Runway is conservatively counted as at least two complete looks beyond baseline and accessory transitions are not promoted to separate outputs.
Stop only when Steve Jobs-like resemblance, black turtleneck, Apple logo, literal identity unknown, and universal-claim insufficiency are all represented separately.
Stop only when the 即梦 card's 免费/AI图片创作工具 scope and the unshown bridge to moving illustration are explicit.
Stop only when gesture/gaze, layout, non-speech audio, same-room continuity, parallel-list structure, and absence of cross-tool handoffs are closed.
Stop only when card promotional truth, all tool workflows/causality, and the complete Manus dependency/accuracy/citation/export set remain unknown where unsupported.
Stop only when every critical question is answered or correctly unknown and the exact meta-gate finds no unchecked channel, meaning change, or global relation.
declaredUnknowns: Specific musical/sound-effect meaning of the non-speech audio; only continuity and ending silence are technically established.

Manus theme input, source materials, content accuracy, citations, editability, export format, and generation attribution.
The image-to-animation program or method between the 即梦 card scope and moving illustrated result.
